leadText:
Pokédex Lecture (Japanese: VSタマゲタケ VS ), titled VS Foongus in the Shogakukan Asia translation, is the 529th chapter of the Pokémon Adventures manga, and the fifth chapter of the .

It is subtitled Foongus (Japanese: ポケデクス・レクチャー Pokédex Lecture) in the VIZ Media translation and Pokédex Lecture in the Shogakukan Asia translation.
